a.title: Alpine Linux and OpenSSH patch flaw that’s as bad as it can get

b.lede: A newly disclosed OpenSSH vulnerability dubbed "*sshole" allows attackers to log in to certain Alpine Linux and other musl-based Linux accounts that are configured to block password authentication, simply by entering an oversized password. [...]
b.title: OpenSSH flaw lets attackers log into password-disabled Linux accounts
